title: Asymptotic expansion for transport maps between laws of multimatrix models
summary: We study the large-$N$ behavior of random matrix tuples $Y^N = (Y_1^N,\dots,Y_d^N)$ with joint density proportional to $e^{-N^2 V}$ for some convex function $V$ in non-commuting variables satisfying certain bounds on its second derivative. We give an asymptotic expansion in powers of $1/N^2$ of the trace of noncommutative smooth functions of $Y^N$. We also give an asymptotic expansion for a family of maps $T^N$ that transport the law of a tuple of independent GUE random matrices to the law of $Y^N$ and, as a consequence, show strong convergence for the multimatrix models $Y^N$.
